description:
• Brand introduction:
Starpower harnesses the power of Web3, DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks), and advanced technologies like IoT, blockchain, and AI to create a global network of energy devices, enabling applications like virtual power plants (VPPs). By linking various energy devices such as air conditioners, water heaters, and storage batteries, Starpower provides schedulable energy resources, contributing to energy efficiency, demand response, and a zero-carbon future.
• Product description:

Starplug is an innovative component of the Starpower ecosystem, designed to seamlessly integrate everyday energy devices into the Starpower network.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Starplug can transform any standard electrical device into a smart, networked energy resource that earns users $STAR rewards.  Connet, Save and Earn.

• Payment terms: 

  • Commission Structure:

    Multi-Level Marketing (MLM) Commissions:

    • Level 1: Earn a 4% commission on the sales made by users you directly refer.
    • Level 2: Earn a 3% commission on the sales made by users referred by your direct referrals.
    • Level 3: Earn a 2% commission on the sales made by users referred by Level 2 referrals.

    Auto Tier Commission:

    • Gold Sales Ambassador: Sell 0-2 units to earn an 8% commission.
    • Platinum Sales Ambassador: Sell 3-9 units to earn a 10% commission.
    • Diamond Sales Ambassador: Sell 10-49 units to earn a 14% commission.
    • Star Diamond Sales Ambassador: Sell 50 or more units to earn a 20% commission.

    Tier Advancement Rules: Your tier is determined by the total number of units sold by you and all your downline users.

  • Payment Schedule:

    • Commissions will be calculated and paid out on a monthly basis.

  • Payment Method:

    • Payments will be made via bank transfer or other agreed-upon payment methods. Ambassadors must provide the necessary banking details or payment information at the start of the engagement.

  • Invoicing:

    • Ambassadors are required to submit an invoice by the end of each month for their commissions. Starpower’s internal tracking systems will verify the sales and commission amounts.

  • Taxes:

    • All payments are subject to applicable taxes. Ambassadors are responsible for reporting and paying any taxes on the commissions received according to their local regulations.

  • Tracking and Management:

    • The UpPromote marketing system will be used to track and manage all marketing activities, ensuring transparency and real-time access to all transactions and commissions.

  • Confidentiality:

    • Payment details and terms are confidential and should not be disclosed to third parties without prior written consent from Starpower.

  • Termination and Adjustments:

    • Adjustments to the payment terms can be made with mutual agreement and must be documented in writing.
